ignored_rules.name: The number and name of arguments passed to a function should match its parameters
ignored_rules.reason: False positives. The analyzer cannot resolve two call targets correctly: (1) super().__init__(id=..., ...) in subclasses of pydantic.BaseModel (app/core/connection_node.py, input_node.py, output_node.py, app/nodes/node.py), whose __init__(**data) accepts these keyword arguments; (2) conn.cursor(dictionary=True) (app/services/mysql_service.py, app/routes/datasets.py): mysql.connector.connect() is typed as a Union that includes PooledMySQLConnection, which delegates cursor() through __getattr__, and the 'dictionary' parameter exists on the real connection classes (mysql-connector-python 9.7.0). This code runs and is covered by tests. The two real findings of the report were fixed: the unknown uvicorn.run() argument limit_max_request_size in app/main.py (commit 088daa8), and getApiContent called with 3 arguments in app/routes/datasets.py (dead code, removed). The 13 findings of the current analysis are all of the two false-positive kinds above.

ignored_rules.name: Mouse events should have corresponding keyboard events
ignored_rules.reason: False positives. In the analyzed commit, 46 of the 56 findings were on <ion-button> / <ion-fab-button>, Ionic web components that render a native <button> in their shadow DOM, so (click) is already triggered by Enter and Space; the other 10 (clickable <ion-icon>, <div>, <ion-card-header>, <ion-radio>, <ion-item>) are no longer reported: these elements became native buttons or received keyboard handlers (commit c1219ea and later). The 3 findings left (clickable <tr> in elastic-dashboard and mysql-dashboard) contain a native <button> in their first cell whose click bubbles to the row, so each row is reachable and operable with the keyboard; a keydown handler on the <tr> would run the selection twice when Enter is pressed on that button.

ignored_rules.name: Videos should have subtitles
ignored_rules.reason: Not applicable. The two <video> elements in render.component.html preview the content of a dataset cell: the video is arbitrary user data sent as a base64 data: URL, for which no caption or description file exists, so there is no <track> source to provide.
